purpose: mechanism-first high-pressure audit of serving burden, source-owned recovery, failure type, and Algorithms 1/2/3; no direction-of-effect or victory threshold is registered
primary_estimand: DES WCT among workflows whose completion changes under a paired one-fault replay, split by source_worker_gpu versus source_node
secondary_estimands: healthy DES WCT including modeled normal-path source-copy burden
added WCT among causally changed workflows
capacity admission, eviction, copy queue, committed recovery, recompute, and AIMD trigger counts
official-rate sparse Poisson mixture retained only as a secondary derived statistic
evidence_boundary: SGLSim metadata DES preliminary mechanism evidence. Both the 500 ms fence-plus-activation and 10/30/60 s replacement inputs are explicitly modeled and unmeasured. The main 60 s cell is a mechanism upper-bound input, not a paper-ready advantage claim. Main hardware remains an A100 40 GiB model; RTX4090 physical data is used only by the separate calibration diagnostic.

policy_failover.replacement_delay_provenance: modeled unmeasured sensitivity input; no Mooncake physical downtime source
policy_failover.fence_activation_provenance: modeled unmeasured mechanism input; not an A100 or production Mooncake measurement

normal_path_copy_burden.semantics: Each request is charged the registered visible fraction of its own admitted source-copy transfer critical path. Copy-lane wait remains in commit timing and is reported separately, but is not repeatedly charged to every queued request as serving burden.

postregistration_sensitivity_diagnostic.evidence_boundary: All three replacement durations are modeled and unmeasured. This is a sensitivity diagnostic, not Mooncake downtime measurement.
